card.name: Age and weight band boundaries in dosing
card.fires_on: Linking words (and, or, to, but) and number digits right after an age or weight cutoff such as "4 years" or "50 kg" in dosing tables.

modes.label: Linker after age or weight
modes.description: The word and, or or to that follows an age or weight value and leads into "older", "greater" or the next band.

modes.label: Digit inside weight range
modes.description: A digit partway through a weight number in a table of weight bands.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing table where an age or weight band is being continued, like "4 years and older".
